svg.title: Shared uplink capacity
svg.desc: Twenty media clients each require 8 Mbit/s: total demand is 160 Mbit/s. A shared 100 Mbit/s uplink provides at most 5 Mbit/s per client under ideal equal sharing, before protocol overhead. Increasing the local uplink to 1 Gbit/s may help, but an unchanged 100 Mbit/s internet edge can remain the bottleneck.

g.text: Find the shared bottleneck before upgrading links
Demand exceeds link capacity before overhead.
A 1 Gbit/s local upgrade may help; check the entire traffic path.
An unchanged 100 Mbit/s internet edge can remain the bottleneck.
